notes.ja: トラックパッド付きキーボードのカクつきと、使用中の再起動を修正。Linux の BLE で Vial につながるように。
notes.en: Fixes choppy trackpads and restarts during use. Vial now works over BLE on Linux.

notes.ja: 10 分間どこにもつながらないと電源オフ（LOW-I かキーボードの抜き挿しで起動）。USB の ID を KB Bridge 専用（7A79:1576）に。Vial に見える ID も KB Bridge のものに。
notes.en: Powers off after 10 minutes without a connection (LOW-I or plugging / unplugging the keyboard wakes it). Dedicated USB ID (7A79:1576), also shown to Vial.
